name: plannotator
description: Standalone CLI for reviewing local changes and annotating documents in the browser
author: backnotprop

scripts.build: bun run build:review && bun run build:annotate
scripts.build:viewer-pin: rm -f apps/guides-show/dist/viewer/manifest.json && bun run --cwd apps/guides-show build:viewer && bun run --cwd apps/guides-show sync:manifest
scripts.test: bun run test:sandbox apps/cli/server/annotate-command.test.ts apps/cli/server/annotate-output.test.ts apps/cli/server/annotate-resolution.test.ts apps/cli/server/strict-annotate-result.test.ts apps/cli/server/review-output.test.ts packages/server/annotate-bundle.test.ts packages/server/annotate-draft.test.ts packages/server/annotate-live-version.test.ts packages/server/live-proxy.test.ts packages/server/request-host.test.ts packages/server/review-workspace.test.ts packages/shared/annotate-target.test.ts packages/shared/annotate-client-lease.test.ts packages/shared/review-core.test.ts packages/shared/review-open-state.test.ts packages/shared/review-draft.test.ts packages/ai/ai.test.ts -- --timeout=15000
